decision: 197fe4版を維持。専用端点操作は削除を改善するが、小規模の末尾追加に約0.5〜1%の再現差が残るため、今回3候補は採用しない。
measurement: Initial GCC:30endpoint conditions x3seeds x5variants; Clang:30conditions x3seeds x4variants. Focus:17conditions x2compilers x3seeds x7rounds x3variants. Pop-only fallback:10small conditions x2compilers x3seeds x7rounds x3variants. Worst small push_back case:8times more repetitions,11alternating rounds.
online_result: Root verified deque submission412370 AC147ms, source matched baseline. No official-case speed claim for rejected candidates.
notes: Production time seed,64bit priorities,Node layout,API and drivers remained unchanged. Only measurement headers use the common fixed seed variable.

Pop candidate directly descends the chosen endpoint, avoids ranks/length comparisons and terminal merge, then recycles after root commitment. Push candidate directly allocates and merges, retaining capacity checks.
All measured processes independently verify cumulative all_prod digests against array prefix/suffix folds; erase_max inputs are sorted before timing.
Combined improves many endpoint cases, but GCC16element noncommutative push_back retains+0.454% in8times longer11round test (baseline52.8876/control52.9016/combined53.1279ms).
Pop-only fallback similarly retains+0.933% in the same long test (baseline52.8966/control52.9360/pop53.3899ms). Small focus also shows Clang noncommutative push_back+1.01% versus control+0.33%.

The pop-only push method body is unchanged; an isolated push-only TU has identical executable sections in both compilers. The mixed-operation benchmark still has a measurable context/code-generation residual, so it is not ignored for the requested performance gate.
No additional candidate was created after the bounded3candidates. Parent decided to retain baseline, so no root fixed-main performance run is required.
No SIMD or other extension path was added. The gain candidates change traversals, not mathematical monoid behavior.
main_performance: 固定main比較runnerは用意したが、直接操作の悪化が再現したため未実行。公式入力14例は生成のみで、今回の速度・正しさ確認済みとは扱わない。
policy_note: 性能上限を証明するものではない。現在の公開API・一般性・前回の改善を保つ条件で、今回試した3案の採用を見送る。
